# MCP tool catalog

Server `nhl-power-ranking` v2.1.0 exposes 47 tools in 10 groups over Streamable HTTP at `https://sports.raglab.services/mcp`.

Authentication and client setup: [developers.md](developers.md).

## Power model

Power metrics, history, cohort, similarity, and outlier analysis

### `get_power_rankings` — Power rankings

All 32 NHL teams ranked by the site's power model with score, 1-day/7-day/30-day score and rank changes, and the snapshot date.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)

### `get_team_power_breakdown` — Team power breakdown

Metric-by-metric breakdown behind one team's power score, including sections, weights, contributions, raw values, normalized scores, league ranks, differentials, and real/proxy/no-data status.

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. TOR
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)

### `get_metric_league` — Metric league table

League-wide table for one power metric built from the latest stored team breakdowns: every team's raw value, formatted display, normalized score, league rank and section, best first, with the league average and top/bottom rows.

Parameters:
- `metric` (required) — Metric key from get_metric_definitions
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)

### `get_power_matrix` — Power metric matrix

One aligned power snapshot for all or selected teams. Returns rank, score, section scores, effective weights and contributions, and optionally every selected metric's raw value, normalized score, league rank, status, unit, and delta inputs.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026
- `teams` (optional) — Team codes to include; defaults to every team
- `sections` (optional) — Section keys to include; defaults to all sections
- `metrics` (optional) — Metric keys to include when includeMetrics is true
- `includeMetrics` (optional) — Include selected leaf metrics; defaults to false
- `includeRaw` (optional) — Include raw metric values; defaults to true

### `compare_cohorts` — Compare power cohorts

Compares two to six team cohorts across selected model scores or oriented raw metrics, with weighted differences, section drivers, coverage, overlap handling, and descriptive caveats.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20262026
- `cohorts` (required) — 
- `comparisonMode` (optional) — 
- `overlapPolicy` (optional) — 
- `metricSelector` (optional) — 
- `featureBasis` (optional) — 
- `weighting` (optional) — 
- `standardize` (optional) — 
- `limit` (optional) — 
- `cursor` (optional) — 

### `find_similar_teams` — Find similar power teams

Finds teams with the closest selected power-profile values to a target team, using deterministic weighted distance, coverage, section drivers, and metric drivers.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20262026
- `target` (required) — Target team code, e.g. TOR
- `candidateSelector` (optional) — 
- `metricSelector` (optional) — 
- `featureBasis` (optional) — 
- `weighting` (optional) — 
- `standardize` (optional) — 
- `minCoverage` (optional) — 
- `limit` (optional) — 
- `cursor` (optional) — 

### `find_metric_outliers` — Find power metric outliers

Finds unusual team-metric values using oriented raw values or model scores with robust MAD/IQR/sample-SD fallback statistics and deterministic result ordering.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026
- `target` (optional) — One team to inspect; omit to inspect the full population
- `metricSelector` (optional) — 
- `featureBasis` (optional) — 
- `method` (optional) — 
- `threshold` (optional) — 
- `minSample` (optional) — 
- `side` (optional) —

### `get_power_history` — Power score history

Paginated daily power-score and rank history for one team from stored snapshots.

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. TOR
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026
- `days` (optional) — Default lookback when from/to are omitted
- `from` (optional) — Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD lower bound
- `to` (optional) — Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD upper bound
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum points to return; default 50
- `cursor` (optional) — Opaque cursor from the previous page

### `get_metric_history` — Power metric history

Paginated raw and normalized history for one validated power metric key.

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. TOR
- `metric` (required) — Metric key from get_metric_definitions
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026
- `from` (optional) — Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD lower bound
- `to` (optional) — Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD upper bound
- `days` (optional) — Default lookback; defaults to 30 days
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum points; default 50
- `cursor` (optional) — Opaque cursor from the previous page

### `get_section_history` — Power section history

Paginated score, effective weight, contribution, factor, and league-range history for one power-model section.

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. TOR
- `section` (required) — Section key from get_metric_definitions
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026
- `from` (optional) — Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD lower bound
- `to` (optional) — Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD upper bound
- `days` (optional) — Default lookback; defaults to 30 days
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum points; default 50
- `cursor` (optional) — Opaque cursor from the previous page

### `explain_power_change` — Explain power-score change

Compares the latest stored breakdown on or before two dates and decomposes the total, rank, section, and metric changes. The decomposition is descriptive, not causal proof.

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. TOR
- `from` (optional) — Baseline YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to seven days before the latest snapshot
- `to` (optional) — Comparison YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the latest snapshot
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026

## Players & value

Player dossiers, salary and contract value, and Power Above Average

### `get_player_profile` — Player profile

Full dossier for one player: identity and bio, viewed-season line, prior NHL seasons, salary cap hit, contract value (PPV), injury status, and the stored Power Above Average row with its ledger.

Parameters:
- `playerId` (required) — NHL player id, e.g. 8478402
- `team` (optional) — Team code to disambiguate a mid-season trade, e.g. EDM
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)

### `get_team_paa` — Team power-above-average ladder

One team's stored Power Above Average rows for a season: a ranked contributors ladder (best or worst first), a complete available-value lookup by player id, and every unscored player with the model's reason.

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. TOR
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)
- `order` (optional) — desc = best contributors (default); asc = the players dragging the team down
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum leaderboard rows; default 10

### `get_paa_leaders` — League PAA leaders

League-wide Power Above Average leaders for a season, ranked best (order=desc) or worst (order=asc), with pagination.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)
- `order` (optional) — desc = top contributors (default); asc = bottom contributors
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum leaders per page; default 10
- `cursor` (optional) — Opaque cursor from the previous page

## Teams

Season games, metric and projection histories, and schedule strength

### `get_team_games` — Team season games

One team's season game list (oldest first) with final state, opponent context, the stored post-game power score/rank and per-game deltas, plus the team's remaining-schedule strength.

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. TOR
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)

### `get_team_metrics` — Team metric trend history

One team's per-metric and per-section score/raw history aligned to its games (oldest first, index-parallel), optionally filtered to selected metric and section keys.

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. TOR
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)
- `metrics` (optional) — Metric keys to include; defaults to every metric
- `sections` (optional) — Section keys to include; defaults to every section

### `get_team_projections` — Team projection history

One team's projected final standing and playoff odds per stored simulation (one row per date, oldest first).

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. TOR
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)

### `get_schedule_strength` — League schedule strength

Remaining-schedule strength for all teams, toughest first: games left, opponents counted, and the average current power score of those opponents.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)

## Games & markets

Projections, scenarios, official evidence, impacts, and market history

### `get_games` — Games for a date

Stored game cards for one date: final or projected score, status, model win probabilities/odds, and sportsbook moneylines when available.

Parameters:
- `date` (optional) — YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to today)
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026

### `get_game_analysis` — Game edge analysis

Stored head-to-head analysis for one game: probabilities, scores, overtime split, model versus market odds, matchup edges, the fair-price scoreline ladder with risk tiers, and available pregame availability context. Set includeCategories=false for the lean payload without section category edges and metric-by-metric matchups.

Parameters:
- `gameId` (required) — Game id from get_games
- `includeCategories` (optional) — Include section category edges and metric matchups from the latest stored breakdowns; defaults to true

### `project_matchup` — Project a matchup

Runs the head-to-head engine for any two teams, scheduled or not, with expected and projected score, win probabilities, overtime split, and metric-by-metric adjusted matchups. Win probabilities come from a sequential 12x5-minute situational ensemble over the H2H base rates.

Parameters:
- `teamA` (required) — First team code (away orientation by default), e.g. TOR
- `teamB` (required) — Second team code (home unless homeTeam is set), e.g. MTL
- `homeTeam` (optional) — Which team gets home ice: a team code, or "none" for neutral site
- `backToBackA` (optional) — First team played the previous day
- `backToBackB` (optional) — Second team played the previous day
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026

### `project_scenario` — Project a matchup scenario

Simulates a baseline and an explicit counterfactual with the event engine (12x5min + OT + shootout). Scenario inputs are per-team capacity multipliers (offense, defense, goaltending, discipline, physicality, shootout, pace), a home-ice factor, and back-to-back goalie selection. Returns simulator reports, numeric diffs and the resolved overrides.

Parameters:
- `teamA` (required) — First team code, e.g. TOR
- `teamB` (required) — Second team code, e.g. MTL
- `homeTeam` (optional) — Home team code, or "none" for neutral; defaults to teamB
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20262026
- `baseline` (optional) — 
- `scenario` (optional) — 

### `find_value_bets` — Find model-market disagreements

Paginated scan of stored game projections against sportsbook moneylines, ranked by expected value with no-vig probability, edge, price, bookmaker, and adjustment status.

Parameters:
- `dateFrom` (optional) — YYYY-MM-DD lower bound; defaults to today
- `dateTo` (optional) — YYYY-MM-DD upper bound; defaults to one day after dateFrom
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026
- `minEdgePct` (optional) — Minimum model edge in percentage points; default 2
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum opportunities per page; default 20
- `cursor` (optional) — Opaque cursor from the previous page

### `get_game_impact` — Completed game power impact

For a final game, compares the stored pre-game and post-game snapshots for both teams and reports score/rank change plus section and metric-level decomposition.

Parameters:
- `gameId` (required) — Game id from get_games

### `get_market_history` — Market price history

Returns locally sampled two-sided NHL moneyline revisions for one game, optionally filtered by bookmaker and UTC date range, with provider update time, local observation time, coverage, and a clearly labeled legacy card fallback.

Parameters:
- `gameId` (required) — Game id from get_games
- `bookmaker` (optional) — Exact bookmaker key, e.g. draftkings
- `from` (optional) — Inclusive UTC observation date YYYY-MM-DD
- `to` (optional) — Inclusive UTC observation date YYYY-MM-DD
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum observations per page; default 100
- `cursor` (optional) — Opaque cursor from the previous page

### `get_game_evidence` — NHL game evidence

Fetches official NHL landing, box-score, and play-by-play evidence for one game; normalizes events with stable IDs, filters and paginates chronologically, and reports component-level coverage and finality.

Parameters:
- `gameId` (required) — NHL game id
- `eventTypes` (optional) — 
- `periods` (optional) — 
- `periodTypes` (optional) — 
- `team` (optional) — Team code or numeric NHL team id
- `playerId` (optional) — 
- `playerRole` (optional) — 
- `fromTime` (optional) — Lower time-remaining bound within each period, e.g. 05:00
- `toTime` (optional) — Upper time-remaining bound within each period
- `includeEventDetails` (optional) — Include source event details on returned events
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum events per page; default 50
- `cursor` (optional) — Opaque event cursor from the previous page

## Live & pregame

Live game state, situation model, commentary, live edges, and pregame availability

### `get_live_game` — Live game state

Current live (or final) game state from the NHL feed: score, period, clock, shots, and the player box score with goalie lines when available. Set includeMetrics=true to also recompute the in-game matchup metrics from this game's play-by-play.

Parameters:
- `gameId` (required) — NHL game id from get_games
- `includeMetrics` (optional) — Recompute in-game matchup metrics from this game's play-by-play; default true

### `get_game_situation` — Live game situation model

Runs the live situation engine for an in-progress game: active situations (score/time A-J plus game-style Grind/Open game/Desperate push), manpower and momentum overlays (PP/PP2/PK/EN/4v4/MOM), the completed and in-progress game situation intervals, win/regulation/OT/shootout/next-goal/comeback probabilities, the resumed 12-segment ensemble, in-game metric factors, and the live model-vs-market edge.

Parameters:
- `gameId` (required) — NHL game id from get_games

### `get_live_edge` — Live model-market edge

Current live win probabilities scored against the stored market moneylines for an in-progress game, using the same fair-price and risk-tier rules as the pregame ladder. Market prices do not update in-game, so quote age is expected to be large and the result is provisional.

Parameters:
- `gameId` (required) — NHL game id from get_games

### `get_game_commentary` — Live game commentary

Narrates the live situation portrait with the configured LLM: a one-sentence teaser and a full read, grounded strictly in the situation model's numbers. Cached per material state change.

Parameters:
- `gameId` (required) — NHL game id from get_games

### `get_pregame_availability` — Pregame availability

Fetches the free pregame feeds for one game: announced starting goalies, injuries with top-6/top-4/line impact, projected line combinations, and the metric overrides those absences imply. Set includeLines=false to skip the line-combination scrape.

Parameters:
- `gameId` (required) — NHL game id from get_games
- `includeLines` (optional) — Fetch projected line combinations (DailyFaceoff); default true

## Standings

Official tables, power standings, and the projected playoff picture

### `get_official_standings` — Official NHL standings

Official NHL standings for a season: league table plus conference and division groupings, with wins, losses, OT losses, points, points percentage, goal differential, streaks and clinch indicators.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)

### `get_power_standings` — Power standings

The league table ordered by the power model: each team's stored power score, official points and rank, grouped into conferences and divisions with playoff-odds context when available.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)

### `get_playoff_bracket` — Playoff bracket

The resolved playoff bracket for a season: seeds, first three rounds, the Final and the champion. Real backfilled results take precedence once complete; otherwise the bracket is the stored playoff ensemble projection.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)
- `simulationId` (optional) — Stored playoff simulation id (defaults to the latest)

### `get_playoff_picture` — Projected playoff picture

Playoff seeds by conference from the latest stored season simulation: top 3 per division plus 2 wildcards, each with projected final points, plus the first team out and the projected cut line. Use list_simulations to inspect a specific run.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026 (defaults to the current season)
- `simulationId` (optional) — Simulation id (defaults to the latest run)

## Simulations

Stored season simulations, game by game

### `list_simulations` — List simulations

Paginated stored season simulations, newest first, with as-of date, status, labels, and projected game count.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026; defaults to all seasons
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum simulations per page; default 50
- `cursor` (optional) — Opaque cursor from the previous page

### `get_simulation` — Simulation details

One stored simulation with every team's projected remaining and projected final record.

Parameters:
- `simulationId` (required) — Simulation id from list_simulations

### `get_simulation_games` — Simulation game results

Paginated game-by-game results from one stored simulation, optionally filtered by team and inclusive date range.

Parameters:
- `simulationId` (required) — Simulation id from list_simulations
- `team` (optional) — Only games involving this team code
- `from` (optional) — YYYY-MM-DD lower bound, inclusive
- `to` (optional) — YYYY-MM-DD upper bound, inclusive
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum games per page; default 200
- `cursor` (optional) — Opaque cursor from the previous page

### `get_projected_standings` — Projected standings

Projected final league, conference, and division standings from one stored simulation.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026
- `simulationId` (optional) — Simulation id; defaults to latest

## NHL data

Base data ingested from the official NHL APIs

### `list_teams` — List NHL teams

All teams for a season with identity, conference, division, logo, and current record.

Parameters:
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026

### `get_team_stats` — Team season stats

Official NHL season reports and player lines for one team. Team reports can be disabled when only player or record fields are needed.

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. BOS
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026
- `includeTeamReports` (optional) — Include raw NHL team reports; defaults to true
- `includePlayers` (optional) — Include skater and goalie stats; defaults to true
- `maxSkaters` (optional) — Skater rows to include; default 12

### `get_team_roster` — Team roster

Current club roster merged with target-season skater and goalie lines, player bios, and persisted injury status.

Parameters:
- `team` (required) — Team code, e.g. TOR
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026

### `get_schedule` — Schedule and rest context

Paginated preseason/regular-season schedule with UTC start times, prior/next games, rest days and hours, back-to-back flags, surrounding opponents, and opponent power rank/score.

Parameters:
- `team` (optional) — Only games involving this team code
- `season` (optional) — Season id such as 20252026
- `from` (optional) — YYYY-MM-DD lower bound; defaults to the next 14 days
- `to` (optional) — YYYY-MM-DD upper bound; defaults to 14 days after from
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum games per page; default 200
- `cursor` (optional) — Opaque cursor from the previous page

## News

Aggregated NHL headlines by team and player

### `get_news` — NHL news

Stored NHL headlines from the aggregated public feeds, newest first, optionally narrowed to one team or player. Each item carries the teams and players it was linked to at ingest.

Parameters:
- `team` (optional) — Only headlines linked to this team code, e.g. BOS
- `playerId` (optional) — Only headlines linked to this NHL player id
- `limit` (optional) — Maximum items per page; default 20
- `days` (optional) — Lookback window in days; default 14

## Reference

Algorithm definitions and season metadata

### `get_metric_definitions` — Metric definitions

Complete versioned definitions for all 81 power metrics, including exact formula, unit, source, window, cadence, direction, sample guidance, missing-value behavior, proxy caveats, weights, normalization, aggregation, and opponent adjustment.

Parameters: none.

### `get_model_manifest` — Power model manifest

Machine-readable manifest for the current power model version: all 81 metric definitions, section and subsection weights, normalization, aggregation, fixed-point opponent adjustment, dynamic overtime reweighting, and model warnings.

Parameters: none.

### `get_seasons` — Available seasons

Seasons the system holds data for, with the current season id. Use a season id with any other tool to analyze a past season.

Parameters: none.
